A Witch is knowing and divine
Who is a Witch to you?
Wearing Jewelry to Set an Intention

To set your intentions, cleanse the piece using sacred smoke, salt, or crystals. Then, hold the jewelry in both your hands and speak your intention over the jewelry three times. Remember your intention when you take the jewelry on or off.

Much like how warriors would wear specific armor for battle, jewelry can be used as a protective shield. Speak a spell of protection over your rings, earrings, necklaces, and bracelets, and feel them absorb any negative energy that comes your way.
Rituals of Adornment to Ground and Center

Wearing specific jewelry can aid you in grounding and centering. For example, adorning yourself with jewelry intentionally imbued with the healing power of crystals can balance, support and transform your energetic body.
Connecting with the Moon’s Magic through Jewelry

Place your jewelry on a windowsill or inside a bit of silk outside to absorb the glow and energy. Do this ritual during a new moon to set new intentions, and during a full moon to charge with powers of release, wholeness, and celebration.

Rituals of adornment can be a way to honor your ancestors. By wearing jewelry handed down through your family, you can honor those who came before you and remember them daily, working with your body as an altar of connection.

I affirm that I am always nourished by the earth, divinely protected, and that abundance comes up through my roots and blossoms in my life.
I affirm that I am always carried on the winds of my inner wisdom, my intuition supports me, and I am able to cultivate balance in my diverse pursuits.

I affirm that I am grounded within the earth, approaching my life through both my intuition and analysis, always in creative flow with clarity.
